comparison.normalization: One common archived global oracle peak across all meshes and time steps; RMS and peak pairwise history differences are divided by this value.

operation.correction: Corrected the pre-run contracted time-grid endpoints from [0, 0.023875] to the observed archive endpoints [0.000125, 0.024]; count and time step remain 192 and 125 microseconds.
operation.historical_status: The first post-processing contract attempt is preserved as POSTPROCESS_FAILED_BEFORE_METRIC_OUTPUT. This corrective contract uses the exact 192-point archived grid from 0.000125 s through 0.024 s. J10 source status and artifacts remain unchanged.
operation.method: At dt=125 microseconds, subtract the adjacent full-order semidiscrete modal-oracle UZ histories on the common archived physical time grid. Normalize the differences by the archived common global oracle peak.
non_operations: no change to historical J10 metrics
operation.scope: Pairwise sensitivity to adding one structured mesh direction at a time. This is not a continuum error, a spatial convergence proof, or an independent mechanics reference.
